column3: “See a hundred return” specifies leaving a hundred remaining.
“Everything” is supplied as the object of devouring.
“By taking bribes” joins two descriptions causally; of justice supplies the object of turning aside.
“Or” replaces the conjunction and before entering the house.
“Stench” supplies an object and interprets not smelling.
The images are grouped at the end, and the star of your gods becomes your star god.
